card.name: The word refer in referral instructions
card.fires_on: Forms of the word refer (refer, referring, referral) in label instructions. It fires when the text tells the clinician to send the patient to a specialist or to see another document.

modes.label: Referral to a specialist
modes.description: Refer, referring or referral before a specialist such as an ophthalmologist or hepatologist.
modes.example: discontinue the drug and<< refer>> the patient to the appropriate specialist for evaluation

modes.label: Pointer to other labeling
modes.description: Refer at the start of a sentence that points the reader to another prescribing information document.
modes.example: monitor for quetiapine-associated adverse reactions.<< Refer>> to the quetiapine prescribing information
